what_it_is.prose:
Indian electronic-component distributor with a public drone-component portfolio (processors, CMOS sensors, GNSS/cellular, motor control, MOSFETs, BMS, power, connectors) drawn from globally sourced brands. A market/component intelligence node, not an OEM. Drone Expo 2026 exhibitor.

Value-chain position in the Atlas: Supplies to → Drone microcontrollers and SoCs (L3); Supplies to → Motor-control power electronics (L3); Supplies to → GNSS navigation modules (L3).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'Distributor'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.
